purpose: Pre-release compatibility of the two known consumers with the 1.0.0 working tree, without consumer source changes.
method: Each consumer is built twice from the same checkout: once with its current kit pin and once with the release tree. Consumer repositories were not modified: builds ran in `git clone --shared` copies in a scratch directory.

consumers.name: Autonomous_Driving_Platform
consumers.checkout: sparse: all tracked files except *.npz, *.jsonl, *.gz, *.pkl and *.mp4 (6 GB repository)

results.build: exit 0 with both kits, no errors
results.lint: 53 identical error lines and identical warnings with both kits; every error is a link to a file the sparse checkout omits or to local .build evidence
results.html_difference: 87 of 88 pages byte-identical. index.html differs only in its site-map card thumbnails: inlined SVGs change from role="img" aria-label="" to aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" (decorative).
results.not_run: lint --strict and build --check on the sparse clone, whose omitted files already fail plain lint identically with both kits.

results.lint: clean, 54 project-registered local-artifact warnings with both kits
results.checks: 67 run; identical outcome with both kits (3 errors only from the documentation interpreter lacking Pillow)
results.html_difference: 7 of 8 published pages byte-identical. overview.html differs only in its two site-map card thumbnails gaining the data-decorative attribute.
results.not_run: build --check and lint --strict: the project's lint keeps 54 registered local-artifact warnings, so strict mode is not its gate.

interpreter: Python 3.12 documentation environment with the pinned requirements
kit_tree: The tree of the commit that adds this receipt; builds used that working tree before commit, after the review fixes.
